meta.title: Omni Memory
meta.description: Long-term memory for any AI host (native DSH plugin, plus MCP / HTTP / OpenAPI / CLI): append-only transcripts, bi-temporal facts, notes with provenance and revision history, and hybrid lexical + vector + graph retrieval fused with RRF. Six tools: write, search, profile, timeline, forget and dream verification, plus a Memory panel in the left navigation.
